title: The Big Question
lines: Gran had been away on a long vacation.
Today she comes back on a train.
Ben and Pam had one big question.
Mom drove them to the station to find out.
The station was full of moms and kids.
A train came in. They ran to look.
Gran was not on it. Pam felt sad.
"Gran has a red hat," said Ben.
So Pam sat and did not stop looking.
Then she saw a red hat by a car.
It was Gran, back from her vacation!
"We found her!" said Ben with a grin.
Gran had a small gift for each of them.

questions.ask: What was Ben and Pam's big question?
questions.listenFor: Which train Gran was on. Lines three and four set it up.

questions.ask: What happened when the first train came in?
questions.listenFor: They ran to look, but Gran was not on it. Pam felt sad.

questions.ask: What would you wear so a friend could spot you? Why?
questions.listenFor: Any answer is fine. Listen for a reason tied to being easy to see.
